Beyond these common types, there exists a distinctive group known as pyrophilous fungi, also called fire-loving fungi, that thrive abundantly in fire-stricken areas.
Pyrophilous fungi have long fascinated researchers, for they can break down burnt remains, mainly charcoal (木炭) and ash, and this power lies at the heart of forest recovery.
